note: The app icon is one parameter: mark is the picked logo id or number from the logo gallery (badge / 02g: the user's pick of 3 Oct 2026; others e.g. planet or 06a). The badge is drawn from packaging/icon/badge/yuki-icon-grids.json into the committed frames packaging/icon/badge-<ramp>/<size>.png by python packaging/make_icon.py --export (a headless browser); other marks from their SVGs packaging/icon/<mark>-<ramp>/. Every build packs the frames into packaging/yuki.ico and copies it to yuki/ui/yuki.ico. Empty keeps the current yuki.ico.
